Once the scheduler is reachable, I'd set it up to:
- post in #coastal-team every Monday at 08:00 America/Chicago, starting Monday 19 October
- cover last week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items
- leave out finance figures such as rates, prices and contract values, and point those to June or Anselm
